Nordea Bank Abp - Financial Calendar

Nordea Bank Abp's financial reporting in 2026

Nordea Bank Abp
Stock exchange release – Financial calendar
1 October 2025 at 10.00 EET

Nordea Bank Abp will publish the following financial reports in 2026:

  • Fourth-quarter and full-year results 2025 on 29 January 2026
  • First-quarter results 2026 on 22 April 2026
  • Second-quarter and half-year results 2026 on 16 July 2026
  • Third-quarter and January-September results 2026 on 15 October 2026

The Annual Report for 2025 will be published in week 9, 2026, at the latest, and the Capital and Risk Management Report for 2025 in week 11, 2026, at the latest.

The Annual General Meeting (AGM) of Nordea Bank Abp will be held on 24 March 2026.

The record date for possible ordinary dividend payment to be decided at the AGM for the financial year 2025 is 26 March 2026. The earliest payment date for such dividend is 2 April 2026.

Nordea follows a silent period that lasts from the fifth banking day after a financial quarter ends until the financial report for the corresponding period has been made public.

You can find Nordea’s financial calendar on nordea.com.

For further information:

Ilkka Ottoila, Head of Investor Relations, +358 9 5300 7058
Media inquiries, +358 10 416 8023 or press@nordea.com

The information provided in this stock exchange release was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contacts set out above, at 10.00 EET on 1 October 2025.

We are a universal bank with a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies – enabling dreams and aspirations for a greater good. Every day, we work to support our customers’ financial development, delivering best-in-class omnichannel customer experiences and driving sustainable change. The Nordea share is listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki, Nasdaq Copenhagen and Nasdaq Stockholm exchanges. Read more about us at nordea.com.
